description:
## 3.3.0 (2026-11-18)

### New Features
- **Doc Scanner:** Hide ads (Doc Scanner) is its own patch, so ads stay gone with or without premium.
- **LinkedIn:** A switch hides the More tab, on by default, instead of a page that often shows "Something went wrong".
- **MX Player Pro:** GmsCore support (MX Player Pro) signs in to Google Drive through MicroG-RE.
- **Truecaller:** Anonymous profile viewing and anonymous search, with switches in Loki Patches › Privacy.
- **Truecaller:** Premium reads as the Gold plan, and the after-call screen is skipped for missed calls too.
- **Truecaller:** Hide ads (Truecaller) is its own patch and removes the ads in call history and the rest of the app, with or without premium.

### Fixes
- **Doc Scanner:** GmsCore support also brings notifications through MicroG-RE, registered with Doc Scanner's original certificate.
- **Doc Scanner:** On a version the bundle does not list, only the drawer row is skipped instead of every patch failing.
- **Doc Scanner:** Enable premium features is now named Enable premium features (Doc Scanner).
- **LinkedIn:** GmsCore support is now named GmsCore support (LinkedIn), like the other apps; if you use it, tick it again once.
- **Splitwise:** GmsCore support also brings notifications through MicroG-RE, registered with Splitwise's original certificate.
- **Truecaller:** Premium no longer switches on Remove ads and trackers; tick it yourself for analytics and advertising-ID removal.
- The Loki Patches entry in the app drawer shows the Loki L.

### Updated App Support
- **Doc Scanner:** Doc Scanner 6.9.14 is supported, next to 6.9.9.
- **LinkedIn:** LinkedIn 4.1.1272 is supported, next to 4.1.1270.
- **Truecaller:** Truecaller 26.44.6 is supported, next to 26.43.5.

**41 patches for 5 apps.** Full list in the [README](https://github.com/lokesh-sparrow/loki-patches#apps).

patches.name: Allow clone
patches.description: Lets the app run under a package name made by the Change package name patch: the app compares its own package name with the original at start-up and shuts itself down when they differ.

patches.name: Declutter
patches.description: Removes the promo banner on the home screen and the cross-promotion and cloud-login cards on the save-success screen.

patches.name: Enable premium features (Doc Scanner)
patches.description: Turns on the app's paid features (unlimited scans, cloud upload, OCR, PDF passwords, compression, signatures, themes). Ads are removed by Hide ads (Doc Scanner).

patches.name: GmsCore support (Doc Scanner)
patches.description: Routes Google sign-in, Google Drive and Firebase push through MicroG-RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Signs the push registration with Doc Scanner's original certificate, so notifications still arrive on a re-signed build, and keeps text recognition (OCR) on real Play services. MicroG-RE has to be installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: Hide ads (Doc Scanner)
patches.description: Removes Doc Scanner's ads (Google AdMob and ironSource): banners, full-screen ads and rewarded ads. Works on its own, with or without premium.

patches.name: AMOLED black bars
patches.description: Turns the dark top bar, bottom bar, side menu and the other screens the app draws pure black, matching the feed that the AMOLED black setting already covers. Needs Material You.

patches.name: Anonymous profile viewing
patches.description: Adds an option (off by default, experimental) to visit profiles without being listed in "Who viewed your profile": the analytics events of profile pages are not sent.

patches.name: Block tracking
patches.description: Adds a switch (off by default) that stops most of LinkedIn's analytics events from being sent.

patches.name: Copy text
patches.description: Long press a post, comment or any other text to select and copy it in place, like on Reddit.

patches.name: Dark app icon
patches.description: Black launcher icon with the white "in", instead of LinkedIn's blue. Chosen when patching: a launcher icon cannot switch with dark mode on its own.

patches.name: Disable double-tap like
patches.description: A double tap on a post or a photo no longer likes it.

patches.name: Download media
patches.description: Puts a download button in the full screen photo, video and document viewer; documents (PDFs and carousels) are saved as a single PDF.

patches.name: Feed filters
patches.description: Adds a set of filters that are off until turned on in Loki Patches: focus mode, celebrations, job cards, reposts, posts from other people's activity, "Recommended for you", video posts, games, the "New posts" pill and "See translation".

patches.name: GmsCore support (LinkedIn)
patches.description: Routes "Continue with Google" and Firebase push through MicroG-RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Signs the FCM registration with LinkedIn's original certificate, so notifications still arrive on a re-signed build. MicroG-RE has to be installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: Hide Premium upsells
patches.description: Drops the Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, on profiles and in the Me panel too.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored (promoted) posts from the feed.

patches.name: Hide bottom tabs
patches.description: Adds switches to take My Network, Jobs and More out of the bottom bar (More is hidden by default).

patches.name: Hide promoted jobs
patches.description: Drops promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and from job searches.

patches.name: Hide suggested posts
patches.description: Drops the "Suggested" posts from people outside your network.

patches.name: Keep feed on reopen
patches.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to LinkedIn, instead of reloading it. Pull down or tap the "New posts" button to load new posts.

patches.name: Material You
patches.description: Takes the colors from your wallpaper (Android 12+): the accent replaces LinkedIn blue and the green of the selected filters, and the backgrounds, cards, bars and borders become Material 3 surfaces. Some screens LinkedIn draws from its servers may keep their own colors.

patches.name: Messaging
patches.description: Drops sponsored messages from the inbox, and adds an optional ghost mode that sends no typing indicators and no read receipts.

patches.name: Open links directly
patches.description: Skips LinkedIn's safety/go warning page and opens external links straight away.

patches.name: Post menu items
patches.description: Adds Copy text, Download photos and videos, and Save document as PDF to the ⋯ menu of posts.

patches.name: Remove gaps and dividers
patches.description: Removes the gray gaps between posts and the dividers between list items, so the feed and the lists read as one flat surface.

patches.name: Sanitize share links
patches.description: Strips the tracking parameters from LinkedIn links that get copied or shared.

patches.name: Swipe between feeds
patches.description: Swipe left and right on the home feed to switch between For you and Network, like on X.

patches.name: Tap to hide in viewers
patches.description: Tap a video or document in full screen to hide the caption and buttons, like photos.

patches.name: All codecs
patches.description: Replaces MX Player's stripped decoder with the custom codec 1.87.0, so AC3, E-AC3, DTS, DTS-HD, TrueHD and MLP audio play. The codec is downloaded while patching from USBhost's public MX_FFmpeg release and checked against its SHA-256, then written into the app: nothing to set up afterwards.

options.description: Optional. Leave empty and the codec is downloaded while patching from USBhost's MX_FFmpeg release and checked against its SHA-256. Pick mx_aio.zip or a libffmpeg.mx.so only to patch offline or to use a different pack.

patches.name: GmsCore support (MX Player Pro)
patches.description: Routes Google sign-in and Google Drive through MicroG-RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services, so MX Player Pro can sign in to Google Drive on a re-signed build. MicroG-RE has to be installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: Skip license check
patches.description: MX Player Pro asks Google Play to confirm the purchase and locks itself when the answer is missing, which is always the case for a patched copy. The check is skipped and the app counts as licensed.

patches.name: AMOLED black (Splitwise)
patches.description: Real black instead of dark grey in Splitwise's dark mode: backgrounds, screens, bottom sheets, the status and navigation bars and the group charts. Cards stay a shade lighter so they stand out. AMOLED screens switch black pixels off, which saves battery. Light mode is unchanged. Can be switched off in Loki Patches > Appearance.

patches.name: Enable premium features (Splitwise)
patches.description: Treats the account as Pro and switches on the paid features: unlimited expense entries, search, charts, spreadsheet export, currency conversion, group totals history and stats, default splits, reminders, balance alerts, trip dates, larger receipt images and itemization.

patches.name: GmsCore support (Splitwise)
patches.description: Routes Google sign-in, Google Drive and Firebase push through MicroG-RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Signs the push registration with Splitwise's original certificate, so notifications still arrive on a re-signed build, and keeps receipt OCR on real Play services. MicroG-RE has to be installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: Hide Pro ads and upsells
patches.description: Removes the full-screen ad after adding an expense, the ad in Activity, the Pro diamond, the Pro account and Pro Duo cards, the Pro Pass prompts, the Pro tour screen, the hiring promo and the rate-the-app prompt.

patches.name: Remove analytics and crash reporting
patches.description: Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and the advertising-ID collection the app declares in its manifest.

patches.name: Enable premium features (Truecaller)
patches.description: Makes the premium features the app decides on the device available, the plan read as Gold instead of Free, hides the after-call screen (switch in Loki Patches > Calls) and lets you view profiles and search numbers without the other person being told (switches in Loki Patches > Privacy). Call Assistant and Family Sharing stay off. Who viewed me, who searched for me, caller ID for unknown numbers and fraud insurance show only what Truecaller's servers send to the account.

patches.name: GmsCore support (Truecaller)
patches.description: Routes Google sign-in, the Google Drive backup of contacts and call logs, and Firebase push through MicroG-RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Signs the FCM registration with Truecaller's original certificate, so notifications still arrive on a re-signed build. MicroG-RE has to be installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: Hide ads (Truecaller)
patches.description: Removes Truecaller's ads: in the call history, the after-call screen, search results and the rest of the app. Works on its own, with or without premium.
